title: The time-stamp check also covers page item and roadmap step writes
why: Triage 6 stamped page item 364 at 14:16 CST while the clock read 14:14 CST. #1447 checks send_message bodies only.
note: Stacked on #1447. Coordinator pick, 14:48 CST (#1447): the stamp guard refuses only a stamp more than 1 minute AHEAD of the clock, not one 3 min off either way. Every incident today ran ahead (2, 8-25 min); a kept old value is always behind, and the symmetric rule both missed the 2-min incident and refused kept old values.
